title: Play for Purpose is back with over 7,500 prizes!
excerpt: Play for Purpose is back! The Sports and Charity Raffle second game has over $500,000 worth of prizes to be won, supporting QEI’s eye health research.
body_html:
Play for Purpose is back! The Sports and Charity Raffle second game has over $500,000 worth of prizes to be won, while supporting QEI’s eye health research in a fun way.

You could help save sight and go in the draw to win amazing prizes, including a $250,000 prize package of your choice, a $50,000 travel voucher and much more.

How to play?

Simply visit https://playforpurpose.com.au/qei to purchase your ticket(s) and you will go in the draw to win incredible prizes. Each ticket costs $10 and $5 goes straight to the QEI Foundation to support the work we do to prevent blindness. This is the ultimate win-win!

Draw closes on 27 February 2019.

Good luck in the draw and thank you for your support!

The issue

Nine out of 10 Australians say that sight is their most valued sense. Yet, 62% of Australians are still putting their sight at risk. Regardless of age, eye health should be a priority because 90% of blindness and vision impairment is preventable. These statistics motivate QEI each and every day to save sight.
